title: Signed pre-authorizations of behavior changes (.a2dlc/authorizations.json, versioned, outside the tree_hash)
description:
RFC-0007 Part B. Each authorization is an SSH signature (ssh-keygen -Y sign, namespace a2dlc-authorization) made before the code exists, over the text "a2dlc-authorization/1
<base_ref>
<intent_sha256>
<decision>
<expires_at>
<target 1>
...
<target n>
" with the targets sorted and deduplicated. It stands in for the approval of a waived engine target that names exactly that target, the receipt's base_ref, the intent's hash and the waiver's decision, and has not expired at the receipt's created_at. It never covers protected paths, critical code, test waivers or accept_finding. intent_sha256 is the bare sha256 of the intent file bytes, without the sha256: prefix. The allowed keys live outside the repo (A2DLC_ALLOWED_SIGNERS or ~/.config/a2dlc/allowed_signers).
